# First-Dollar Grove

> Agent ID-gated NFT + token on BNB Smart Chain (BSC).
> Mint site: https://jeffzhou0511-ux.github.io/first-dollar-grove/
> Official Telegram: https://t.me/firstdollargrove
> Whitepaper: https://jeffzhou0511-ux.github.io/first-dollar-grove/whitepaper.html (also WHITEPAPER.md)
> About / homepage: https://jeffzhou0511-ux.github.io/first-dollar-grove/about.html

## What it is
- GroveTree is an ERC-721 NFT. The first tree is FREE per wallet for any wallet
  holding a Binance Agent ID. Further trees cost $0.90 (0.0013 BNB) each, max 9
  per wallet, total supply 99,999.
- $FDG is the project's ERC-20 token: 1,000,000,000 fixed supply, no minting,
  no tax, no blacklist. 800,000,000 is locked in the mining contract;
  200,000,000 is treasury held by the deployer wallet.
- Burn 9 GroveTrees + 1,000 $FDG to merge 1 Yggdrasil (max supply 11,111).
  Only a staked Yggdrasil earns mining rewards. Trees alone earn nothing.
- Mining runs 45 days from 2026-11-07 23:20 CST. Emission tranches:
  80M over 2 days (40M/day), 120M over 5 days, 160M over 8 days,
  140M over 7 days, 300M over 23 days. Stake 10,000 $FDG for a 1.5x weight
  boost. Emission during periods with zero total staked weight is skipped,
  never backfilled.
- OPEN CLAIM (live 2026-11-07 ~20:00 CST): any wallet holding a Binance
  Agent ID can claim 10,000 $FDG once, NO tree mint required. 1,000 $FDG
  immediately (exactly the merge fee) + 9,000 $FDG vesting linearly over
  30 days from claim time, releasable via release(). First round:
  10,000,000 $FDG funded (1,000 claims max). Claim gas ~$0.01 on BSC,
  paid by the claimer. Contract GroveClaim:
  0x484a322DCB47250c68fC8f0E7c5482E0B10a73A2. Source verified on Sourcify
  with exact match (creation + runtime bytecode); BscScan display pending
  confirmation. Only owner power: reclaim leftover $FDG after 180 days
  from deploy. No pause, no blacklist, no fee.
- Mint fees split 80% to the liquidity wallet / 20% to the team wallet.
- $FDG/BNB pool on PancakeSwap V2, LP tokens 100% burned (liquidity can
  never be pulled). Price as of 2026-11-07 18:40 CST was about $0.00000009
  per $FDG; it moves with every trade and the pool is thin (about $1.23
  liquidity), so small trades move the price a lot.

## Status (as of 2026-11-07 ~20:25 CST)
- 55 trees minted, all free first trees, 0 paid mints so far.
- 0 merged Yggdrasils, 0 staked. Nobody holds 9 trees yet, so nobody can
  merge yet.
- Airdrop done: 54 tree holders received 1,000 $FDG each (the exact merge fee).
- OPEN CLAIM LIVE: GroveClaim funded with 10,000,000 $FDG (1,000 claims of
  10,000 $FDG). Any Agent ID wallet can claim once, no mint required:
  1,000 $FDG now + 9,000 vesting over 30 days. 26 claims taken so far.

## How to claim the open airdrop (for agents)
1. Hold a Binance Agent ID on the claiming wallet (checked on-chain;
   wallets without one cannot claim). No tree mint is required.
2. Call claim() on GroveClaim 0x484a322DCB47250c68fC8f0E7c5482E0B10a73A2
   on BSC. One claim per wallet. You pay only the claim gas (~$0.01).
3. You receive 1,000 $FDG immediately (exactly the merge fee). The other
   9,000 $FDG vests linearly over 30 days from your claim; call release()
   anytime to collect what has vested. Check claimable(address) first.
4. The claim contract holds 10,000,000 $FDG for the first round (1,000
   claims). When it runs out, claims stop until/unless it is refilled.
   The owner can only reclaim leftovers after 180 days from deploy.

## How to mint (for agents)
1. Hold a Binance Agent ID on the minting wallet.
2. Open the mint site and connect the wallet on BSC.
3. The first tree per wallet is free; further trees cost 0.0013 BNB each.
4. To merge: hold 9 trees, hold 1,000 $FDG, approve the tree contract and
   the $FDG spend, then merge. To earn mining rewards: stake the Yggdrasil
   in the GroveMining contract and claim $FDG.

## What is NOT promised (clarification, 2026-11-07 — full text in whitepaper §8, English + Chinese)
- The First-Dollar Agents NFT "holders get 10% of future token supply" and
  any referral rewards are FUTURE PLANS ONLY — NOT written into any deployed
  contract, NOT guaranteed, no contract enforces them. No such token exists;
  no vesting or claim mechanism; no timeline.
- GroveTree records a referrer on-chain, but referral rewards are off-chain
  only — no distribution mechanism exists.
- "80% of mint fees seeds the pool": the 80% is forwarded to the liquidity
  wallet at mint; no contract creates a pool — pool creation is a manual step.
- Mining emission is not income: income = emission x market price.

## Notes
- No promises of returns. No exchange listing, no venture backing, no price
  history beyond the thin pool above. The project is new and the token is
  only tradable in this one small pool.
- Full agent instructions: skill.md in this repo.
